import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int N, K, MOD, MAX_VAL;
    static int[] POPCNT = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] F = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] A = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] B = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] C = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long MOD_SQUARED;
    static long[][] WORK = new long[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] FACTORIAL = new long[MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] INV_FACTORIAL = new long[MAX_SIZE];

    static long power_mod(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void setup_factorials() {
        FACTORIAL[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            FACTORIAL[i] = FACTORIAL[i-1] * i % MOD;
        INV_FACTORIAL[MAX_VAL] = power_mod(FACTORIAL[MAX_VAL], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            INV_FACTORIAL[i] = INV_FACTORIAL[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
    }

    static int next_power_of_two(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void fast_walsh_transform(int[] data, int length, boolean is_inverse) {
        long[] temp = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) temp[i] = data[i];
        
        if (is_inverse) {
            for (int block = 1; block < length; block <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < length; i += block << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < block; ++j) {
                        temp[i + block + j] = (temp[i + block + j] - temp[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int block = 1; block < length; block <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < length; i += block << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < block; ++j) {
                        temp[i + block + j] = (temp[i + block + j] + temp[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
            data[i] = (int)(temp[i] % MOD);
            if (data[i] < 0) data[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static void normalize(long[] value, int idx) {
        if (value[idx] >= MOD_SQUARED) value[idx] -= MOD_SQUARED;
    }

    static void transform_multiply() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(WORK[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            A[POPCNT[i]][i] = F[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_transform(A[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    normalize(WORK, i + j);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    WORK[i + j][idx] += 1L * A[i][idx] * B[j][idx];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                C[i][idx] = (int)(WORK[i][idx] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_transform(C[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            F[i] = C[POPCNT[i]][i];
    }

    static void transform_square() {
        int[][] buffer = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(WORK[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    normalize(WORK, i + j);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    WORK[i + j][idx] += 1L * B[i][idx] * B[j][idx];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                buffer[i][idx] = (int)(WORK[i][idx] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_transform(buffer[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(B[i], 0);
        
        for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
            B[POPCNT[idx]][idx] = buffer[POPCNT[idx]][idx];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_transform(B[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD_SQUARED = 1L * MOD * MOD;
        
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(power_mod(K, N));
            return;
        }
        
        F[0] = 1;
        MAX_VAL = next_power_of_two(N + 1) - 1;
        setup_factorials();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            POPCNT[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            B[POPCNT[i]][i] = (int)INV_FACTORIAL[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fast_walsh_transform(B[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        int original_k = K;
        while (K > 0) {
            if ((K & 1) == 1) transform_multiply();
            K >>= 1;
            if (K > 0) transform_square();
        }
        
        long answer = (power_mod(original_k, N) - FACTORIAL[N] * F[N] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
